adjustments.rule: ENFORCE_JSON_REPAIR: Extract JSON between outermost { } before parsing. Strip markdown code fences.
MIN_WORD_ENFORCEMENT: If any section < 150 words, trigger targeted expansion pass.
LATEX_SAFETY: Use \text{} wrappers for all units. Prefer simple notation over complex LaTeX.
MCQ_ISOLATION: Generate MCQs in a separate, dedicated API call with MCQ-specific prompt.
